title: Finite local-Q2 positive replica folding and phase-mixture convexity
question: Can the local measured-Q2 quantity for an actual finite Q3 split history be folded exactly into a positive two-copy operator expectation without a dimension, volume or history-length prefactor, and what remains before this gives a local collar estimate?

theorem.setting: A finite-dimensional Hilbert space, a faithful reference state rho, an output state sigma, and a finite local PVM {E_j} with p_j=Tr(E_j rho)>0 and q_j=Tr(E_j sigma).
theorem.heisenberg_identity: If sigma=U W rho W* U*, then Q2=Tr[(rho tensor rho)(W*U* tensor W*U*)K_(rho,E)(UW tensor UW)].
theorem.positivity: K_(rho,E) is positive. The folding identity has equality constant one and introduces no dimension, volume or prefix-length prefactor.
theorem.reference_normalization: For sigma=rho, the replica expectation equals one.
theorem.common_weight_mixture: For common nonnegative phase weights w_s, p=sum_s w_s p_s and q=sum_s w_s q_s imply Q2(q||p)<=sum_s w_s Q2(q_s||p_s). The two-phase scalar gap is w1*w2*(p2*q1-p1*q2)^2/[p1*p2*(w1*p1+w2*p2)].
theorem.diagonal_peel: Any unitary D commuting with every E_j leaves the measured probabilities and local Q2 unchanged when it is the outermost conjugation. This includes a pure coordinate-diagonal source or bond history.

verification_contract.lean_scope: finite-sum collision/replica identity, reference normalization, and exact two-phase mixture-gap identity

promotion_boundary: R-362 closes FI-2a, the finite positive operator folding, but not FI-2b, the source/volume/cutoff/history-uniform localization of the Heisenberg-evolved witness to a spacetime collar.
next_action: Attack FI-2b in the doubled Heisenberg picture: center K by its reference expectation, peel terminal coordinate-diagonal layers exactly, and prove a state-weighted shell commutator or conditional-expectation estimate for the remaining onsite-interspersed witness. Register a scoped obstruction if its constants grow with cutoff, collar radius or prefix length.
boundary: Finite exact algebra and finite actual-Q3 verification only. No Euclidean path positivity theorem, local influence contraction, uniform local-Q2 bound, common core, all-shape dynamics, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, mass gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure follows.
no_overclaim: An equality-constant-one replica folding removes an artificial path-count prefactor; it does not bound the norm or state-weighted tails of the evolved collision witness.
